name: poindeo-mcp
description: Poindeo video editor agent tools (local MCP server)

interface.shortDescription: Let agents edit real videos in the Poindeo editor
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the Poindeo browser-based video editor: read projects, import media, add zoom points and camera moves, verify framing with frame captures, and export finished MP4s via a local MCP server.
